1.text: {name} watches the scenery outside the window as the shuttle ambles along the road towards {possessive} new home for the next two years.
Trees bleed into pristine white buildings and clear blue skies– it’s a nice day out.

1.speaker: Shuttle Conductor
1.text: Stopping soon at Astraea University. Next stop, Astraea University.

1.speaker: {name}
1.text: Crap. That’s my stop. I didn’t realize it’d be such a short trip.

1.speaker: {name}
1.text: Everything here is so sparkly– it’s hard to believe that this university is hundreds of years old when some of the buildings look brand new. It’s almost … unsettling.

1.speaker: {name}
1.text: I was here last week to talk to auntie … but .. I don’t really recognize anything. Maybe it’s just too new to me.

1.speaker: {name}
1.text: After everything, after... Mom. I need this.

1.speaker: Shuttle Conductor
1.text: Now arriving at Astraea University. Arriving, Astraea University.

1.speaker: {name}
1.text: Oops. That’s me. Hopefully Jay won’t be hard to find. He said he’d meet me at the shuttle stop, but there’re more than a few people here … maybe he’ll find me before I find him?

1.speaker: {name}
1.text: He said green sweater and blue jeans … ah, that might be him over there?

2.text: {name} steps off the bus into the sunlight. The shuttle terminal is moderately populated, with people hopping off other shuttles or waiting for others.
As {subject} walks towards who {subject} thinks might be Jay, an attractive white-haired student about {object} age bumps roughly into {object}.

2.speaker: {name}
2.text: Ouch– hey! Sorry, I didn’t mean to bump into y–

2.speaker: Unknown
2.text: Tch. Hey. Your eyes for decoration? Watch yourself.

2.speaker: {name}
2.text: Wow, rude... He was … kinda gorgeous, though? Ugh.

2.speaker: {name}
2.text: Hey. Don’t be rude. You walked into me just as much as I walked into you.

2.speaker: Unknown
2.text: Are you serious? Do you even know who I am?.

2.speaker: {name}
2.text: I know you’re an asshole. That right?

2.speaker: Narrator
2.text: The stranger scoffs and walks off, leaving {name} on their own once more.

2.speaker: {name}
2.text: Wow, hopefully I never see him again.

2.speaker: {name}
2.text: My bad. Is your stuff alright?

2.speaker: Unknown
2.text: It’s none of your business.

2.speaker: {name}
2.text: Huh? How rude!

2.speaker: Narrator
2.text: Shaking off the strange interaction, Roxanne continues walking over to Jay. He’s standing in the shade of a pretty tree, tapping his foot as he waits. He’s tall, and friendly-looking.

2.speaker: Jay
2.text: Hi! Roxanne? I don’t see any other pretty girls wearing white and blue around here, so I must be right.

2.speaker: Jay
2.text: I’ll be your tour guide on this fine afternoon.

2.speaker: {name}
2.text: Um... Yeah! Sure. That’s me. You’re ... Jay?

2.speaker: Jay
2.text: Sorry, didn’t mean to make it weird or anything. Just thought I’d lighten the mood a little.

2.speaker: Jay
2.text: We can start the tour right away, if you’re ready!  It’s not a big campus, but there’re a lot of important things to see.

2.speaker: {name}
2.text: That’s me! And I don’t see any other cute guys in green here, so you must be Jay.

2.speaker: Jay
2.text: Hah! Gosh, no need for flattery. Ready to get going?

2.speaker: Jay
2.text: It’s not a big campus, but there’re a lot of important things to see.

2.speaker: {name}
2.text: I am, yeah.

2.speaker: Jay
2.text: Neat. Wanna get going now? Or do you need a minute?

2.speaker: Jay
2.text: It’s not a big campus, but there’re a lot of important things to see.

2.speaker: Jay
2.text: It’s not a big campus, but there’re a lot of important things to see.

2.speaker: {name}
2.text: We can go ahead. Also, I bumped into a guy earlier, and... he was kind of rude.

2.speaker: {name}
2.text: Is that normal around here? Should I … watch out for that? Or ..?

2.speaker: Jay
2.text: Oh, ouch. Maybe he just was havin’ a bad day. Not everyone here’s like that though, promise.

2.speaker: Jay
2.text: You’ll find your people one way or another. In my experience, people here are pretty friendly!

2.speaker: Jay
2.text: Come on, we have a lot to look at, people to meet!
